name: Gemini CLI
description: Registers Polter's MCP server with Google's Gemini CLI and mirrors Polter's skills into ~/.gemini/skills/polter-*.

skills.title: Install skills as well
skills.description: yes mirrors Polter's skills into this host's skills directory. Polter's skill_read has to be thought of first; a host's own skills are matched against what the user asked for, which is the whole difference. no registers the MCP server and nothing else.

rules.title: Write Polter's note into this CLI's rules file
rules.description: yes writes a marked block into the user-level rules file (never a project one) saying that what an agent prints reaches nobody, and pointing at the operating-a-terminal skill. It is there because a skill is matched against what the user asked for and nothing matches "you have just finished a task": on real records, 71 tasks produced 15 done reports. Everything outside the markers is left untouched, and no takes the block back out.
